post.yt_title: 5 CRM fields to define before you import anything #Shorts
post.caption:
Define these before importing anything.

5 CRM fields that keep your data clean:
01 Unique ID (email or domain) to catch duplicates
02 Lifecycle stage as a fixed dropdown
03 Owner: one named person per record
04 Lead source
05 Next step date, so no lead goes quiet

Moving to a new CRM? Book a free 30-minute scoping call. Link in bio.

#crm #salesops #dataquality #smallbusiness #automation #hubspot
post.yt_description:
Five CRM fields to define before you import any data: a unique ID (email or website domain) to catch duplicates, lifecycle stage as a fixed dropdown, a named owner per record, lead source, and a next step date. Then test the import on a small sample first.

Moving to a new CRM? Book a free 30-minute scoping call with Xenova Solutions: https://xenovasolutions.com/contact
